messages:
incident-bot: PAGING — Incident 5123 — elevated 429s on /v1/generate (hosted, region=us-west-2). Start 2026-03-15T14:11:30Z. Error class: rate_limit. Affected paths: streaming + sync text-gen. Automated detection flagged bursty keys.
Alex W: I'm on the page. seeing a lot of short burst traffic from a handful of keys, not widespread failures but enough to cause client retries and cascades. P95 latency up ~300ms.
Maria D: any customer reports? I see one support ticket from acme-inc that aligns. their client reported duplicate responses when retrying streaming.
Jordan S: confirming — logs show lots of immediate backoff attempts in <1s windows. clients with aggressive retry loops causing self-throttling.
Alex W: initial mitigation plan: 1) temporary conservative rate-limit enforcement per-key (soft 20% reduce) 2) push recommended client-side guidance to reduce retry aggressiveness and require idempotency tokens 3) disable streaming multiplexing for affected host pool as quick toggle. Who can do the per-key soft-limit patch?
Lee P: I can apply soft limits via edge shaper — will apply rule to suspected keys in us-west-2 now. ETA ~2m.
client-sdk-bot: note: pushing a small advisory to client SDKs is possible via /status endpoint, but prod SDK versions do not auto-fetch; will share snippet for docs.
Maria D: while Lee does the edge change, we should immediately post a short, copy-paste SDK mitigation note for customers and internal SEs: reduce retry attempts, switch to exponential backoff with jitter, and add idempotency tokens for non-idempotent endpoints. Also suggest disabling client-side streaming fallbacks.
Alex W: drafting the guidance below — please review quickly and ack so SEs can paste to customers.
Alex W: "Client mitigation snippet — short-term emergency guidance:
- Reduce retry attempts: reduce maxRetries to 2 for transient 429/5xx.
- Use exponential backoff with base=200ms, multiplier=2.0, maxDelay=5s. Add full jitter.
- Ensure idempotency: include an idempotency_key header per user/request where applicable.
- On 429, do NOT immediately retry if Retry-After header present; respect header.
- Disable streaming-to-sync fallback; force single attempt for streaming requests.
Example (pseudo config):
```json
{
  "maxRetries": 2,
  "backoff": { "baseMs": 200, "multiplier": 2.0, "maxMs": 5000, "jitter": "full" },
  "idempotencyHeader": "Idempotency-Key",
  "streamingFallback": false
}
```
Example curl to set idempotency header:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
"
Maria D: small wording suggestions — call out Retry-After handling explicitly and show pseudocode for exponential backoff with full jitter. Also add note: "If you cannot set idempotency keys, reduce concurrency per-client to 1-2 active requests."
Jordan S: Lee — any update on soft limits?
Lee P: applied soft-per-key limit (20% throttle) to the 7 offending keys in us-west-2. Monitoring for 90s.
client-sdk-bot: draft ready for SEs, can paste to customer templates. Also pushing a short GitHub issue to client-sdk repository to introduce emergency env var REDWOOD_EMERGENCY_BACKOFF that toggles the conservative policy for auto updates.
Alex W: I'll post a brief internal note to #support and #sales with the copy and the action items. Maria, can you own the customer-facing text?
Maria D: on it. I will also add explicit snippet for Node/Python showing random-jitter implementation.
Jordan S: observations after throttle: 429 rate dropped by ~60% in the affected pool and tail latency improved. We're still seeing a few misbehaving clients that need idempotency fixes.
Alex W: next steps: - keep soft limits for 15m and monitor - SEs to contact top offending customers with SDK snippet and ask for idempotency + reduce retries - prepare rollback if customer impact > acceptable (contact oncall).
Maria D: posted to support with copy. tagging @SE leads for outreach.
Lee P: leaving monitoring on. will escalate to emergency quota change if traffic rebounds after 15m.
Alex W: thanks team. if we get more 429s or customer complaints escalate, we'll re-open. closing this thread in 30m unless new developments. :thumbsup:
